build.beforeDevCommand: unset npm_config_prefix && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22.22.3 --silent && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: unset npm_config_prefix && export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && (nvm use 22.22.3 --silent 2>/dev/null || nvm use default --silent 2>/dev/null) && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* https://api.bilibili.com https://api.lrclib.net; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' file: mediastream:;
